QuestInfo.name: Intermediate Hideout Repair
QuestInfo.0: According to the Papyrus Brothers, the toxic gas that has been gathering lately is related to the corrosion of the local iron.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat #r#o2400301##k monsters, the source of the toxic gas, in #b#m402000111##k and #b#m402000112##k, and obtain the #b15 #t4036141#s#k requested by the Papyrus Brothers.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the #o2400301# monsters, the source of the toxic gas, and obtained the #t4036141#s requested by the Papyrus Brothers.

0.msg: We don't know why, but there are way more #r#o2400301#s#k in the Garbage Dump than usual. The toxic gas they release is clearly what's been corroding the iron around here.\r\n

1.msg: It's also obvious that repairing the secret entrance is only a temporary measure! If you don't want to be doing the same thing again this time next year, we need to get to the root of the problem--reducing the amount of toxic gas in the air.\r\n

3.msg: Thank you! You understand! I tell you, I have a hard time convincing people to do the real fix instead of the fast, crummy fix. But since you see it my way, let's do the real fix! Let's get rid of the #rMutant Hedgehog#k! Think you can do it?\r\n
